Name: (1.6 Port) Better Weapons
Author: Applepatapon
Description:
1.6 Port of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17367?tab=description]Better Weapons[/url] that fixes the projectiles images, whilst also adding special attacks to the new weapons.

New changes:
[list]
[*]Holy Blade: Faster Cooldown.
[*]Ossified Blade: Shoots a bouncy skull and bones on the side.
[*]Meowmere: Sprays 9 Prismatic shards that bounces twice.
[*]Leah's Whittler: Blocks and shoots a driftwood.
[*]Alex's Bat: Shoots a super bouncy ball.
[*]Maru's Wrench: Normal special attack to shooting the wrench diagonally.
[*]Penny's Fryer: Normal special attack to shooting a roots platter.
[*]Abby's Planchette, Seb's Lost Mace, Elliott's Pencil, and Haley's Iron: No Changes.
[/list]
